name: dwarven plate
protection_note: Rune-worked steel from the forges under the mountain: it takes a hammer's ring and the forge's heat.
protection_price: It is heavier than steel, and it conducts lightning.
lore_descriptor: dark blue-gray steel with dwarven runes cut small at every joint
first_pickup_chronicle: Dwarven plate. The runes at the joints hold the metal together somehow. I hit it with a hammer to check. It won. My wrist lost.
